verdict.rationale: Zulip explicitly documents incoming webhooks as a native integration type (zulip-docs-19) alongside 130+ native integrations (zulip-docs-9/13), and its API includes a straightforward 'send a message' endpoint (zulip-docs-5) backed by a full OpenAPI spec (zulip-probe-5) and live-verified API (zulip-probe-4). This matches the standard incoming-webhook-posts-to-channel pattern. Missing for 10: a first-party doc snippet showing the exact incoming-webhook URL format/config screen, and independent third-party confirmation of webhook setup ease.
